title: Frame property of the clearing contract
statement: For every natural number $k$, every work-tape index $i<k$, and every input word $x$ over an alphabet $\Gamma$, the contract for clearing tape $i$ has the following frame property: for each word $w$ and each starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state that satisfies the contract's precondition, the endpoint agrees with $d$ on every work-tape cell outside the set that, on tape $i$, is the half-open interval from the initial head position through the position just before the initial head position plus $|w|$, and, on every other tape, is empty.
hypotheses_covered: starting configuration in the sweep state
replaced:
Fix a number $k$ of work tapes, a tape index $i<k$, and an input word $x$. For every
word $w$ and every configuration $d$ whose state is the sweep phase and whose tape $i$,
from its head position through offsets $-1$ to $|w|$, stores the buffer encoding of $w$,
the clearing machine's contract preserves every work-tape cell outside the interval from
the head position on tape $i$ up to but excluding that position plus $|w|$; on every
other tape, it preserves every cell.
